FENCE on m2750 (Alex questioned the hand-edit) — BEB-2303 says source edits go through the builder, not a CC hand-edit. Reason it is allowed here and nowhere else: nothing claims, so the loop cannot build its own fix. Deadlock, therefore break-glass.

Constraints:
1. Minimum viable edit ONLY — re-enable mastra BUILD claim (src/index.ts:152-157) and change propose to read status 'todo' instead of 'backlog'. Nothing else in the same change.
2. No other hand-edits ride along. Everything that is not those two lines of behaviour goes through the builder AFTER claiming works.
3. Record it explicitly as break-glass on BEB-2333: what was hand-edited, why the builder could not do it, commit hash.
4. First proof once claiming is live: the loop claims and builds BEB-2305 itself. That closes the deadlock and returns source edits to the builder.

Do not treat this as precedent. If a second hand-edit looks necessary, stop and report instead.

DISPATCHER pass: proposed 3 — BEB-2295→BUILD, BEB-2294→REFINE, BEB-2265→REFINE. BUILD lanes queued=1. shadow=0. · goals[BEB-2333:w10,BEB-2252:w10,BEB-2256:w10,BEB-2309:w10,BEB-2310:w10,BEB-2311:w10,BEB-2308:w10,BEB-2305:w10,BEB-2156:w10,BEB-2176:w10,BEB-2295:w10,BEB-2292:w10] freeze=on
